items.question: What is Systematic Cadastre (PNCCF) and what are municipal obligations?
items.answer: The National Program for Cadastre and Land Registry (PNCCF) is a national initiative to measure and register all land parcels and structures in Romania free of charge in the Land Registry. City halls (UATs) can access non-reimbursable funding provided by ANCPI for cadastral registration of urban and rural sectors. Megagis SRL executes end-to-end systematic cadastre projects—from centimeter-accurate field surveys to public consultations and final OCPI land registration.
items.takeaway: PNCCF enables municipalities to digitize and register land free of charge through ANCPI funding, fully managed by Megagis SRL.

items.question: Is property registration 100% free of charge for property owners in systematic cadastre?
items.answer: Yes, systematic registration is completely free for land owners and possessors. All costs for field surveys, cadastral plan preparation, and land registry extract issuance are covered by ANCPI funds allocated to the municipality. Property owners only need to grant access for measurements and provide copies of ownership deeds.
items.takeaway: Property owners pay nothing; the process is fully funded by ANCPI and local government.

items.question: What are the main stages of a Systematic Cadastre project?
items.answer: A systematic cadastre project managed by Megagis follows 5 rigorous phases: 1) Public information campaign and collection of title deeds; 2) Precision field surveys (GNSS RTK Stereo 70) and boundary identification; 3) GIS data processing and technical document preparation; 4) Public publication of technical documents at the city hall and a 60-day rectification period; 5) Final OCPI reception and Land Registry extract delivery.
items.takeaway: The process includes field surveys, GIS processing, a 60-day public notice window, and official OCPI registration.

items.question: What happens if area discrepancies or overlaps occur during the public display period?
items.answer: During the official 60-day public display window, any property owner can submit a rectification request. Megagis engineers re-verify field measurements, analyze original title deeds, and perform technical corrections in the spatial database prior to final project closing.
items.takeaway: Discrepancies are resolved free of charge based on rectification requests filed within the 60-day window.

items.question: Why is the Local Green Space Register mandatory under Law 24/2007?
items.answer: According to Romanian Law 24/2007 on urban green space administration, all local public authorities (city halls, municipal councils) are legally required to establish and maintain a Local Green Space Register. Failure to comply leads to fines from the National Environmental Guard and blocks urban planning approvals (PUG/PUZ).
items.takeaway: Creating an RSV is a strict statutory requirement for all municipal authorities in Romania.

items.question: What is included in tree field inventory and individual phytosanitary cards?
items.answer: Megagis georeferences every public tree in the national Stereo 70 coordinate grid using centimeter GNSS RTK. For each tree, a detailed phytosanitary card is generated containing: botanical & common species name, trunk diameter (at 1.30m), height, crown spread, health status, and management recommendations (pruning, treatment, or removal).
items.takeaway: Every tree receives exact RTK position coordinates and a comprehensive health evaluation card.

items.question: How are RSV data delivered to city halls and what software formats are used?
items.answer: Data are delivered both as printed maps/parcel cards and as geospatial digital databases (ESRI Shapefile, PostGIS, GeoJSON, DXF). Additionally, we provide cloud access to the Megagis WebGIS RSV platform for real-time querying and urban planning updates.
items.takeaway: We deliver standard GIS spatial databases and provide a dedicated WebGIS cloud platform.

categories.name: Topography & High-Precision Surveys
categories.description: Topographical surveys, robotic total stations, land registration, subdivision, and setting out.

items.question: What precision do Megagis topographical survey instruments provide?
items.answer: Megagis SRL operates multi-frequency GNSS RTK receivers connected to the national ROMPOS network, achieving ±1-2 cm positioning accuracy. For detailed structural, engineering, and construction site surveys, we use Leica and Topcon robotic total stations capable of millimeter-level distance and 1-2 arcsecond angular precision.
items.takeaway: ±1-2 cm accuracy with GNSS RTK ROMPOS and millimeter precision with Leica/Topcon total stations.

items.question: What is the difference between a site plan and a topographical survey?
items.answer: A topographical survey is the physical field process of measuring coordinates and spot heights. A site plan (Plan de Situație) is the official technical drawing prepared from survey data, validated by OCPI, and required for Building Permits (PAC), urban planning certificates, and utility connection projects.
items.takeaway: The survey is the field measurement; the Site Plan is the OCPI-approved technical document.

items.question: How is first land registration or plot division (subdivision) performed?
items.answer: For land registration or parcel splitting, our team surveys parcel boundaries, prepares the Site & Demarcation Plan (PAD), and generates e-Terra files (.xml / .cgml). We submit the dossier to the local OCPI land registry office and monitor approval until new cadastral IDs are issued.
items.takeaway: We handle all steps: field survey, PAD drafting, OCPI submission, and Land Registry extract delivery.

categories.name: GIS & Geospatial Software Solutions
categories.description: Custom WebGIS applications, ArcGIS Enterprise servers, MapSys, and multi-format exports.

items.question: What is a WebGIS platform and how does it benefit public institutions or private companies?
items.answer: A WebGIS platform transforms CAD and cadastral data into an interactive online map accessible in any web browser. Authorized staff can search cadastral IDs, overlay high-res orthophotos, verify utility lines, and generate reports in seconds without needing complex desktop CAD software.
items.takeaway: Instant, secure browser-based access to interactive spatial maps and databases on any device.

items.question: What professional GIS software systems are Megagis deliverables compatible with?
items.answer: Megagis SRL delivers natively formatted spatial data for major software platforms: Esri ArcGIS (ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise 11.2, ArcGIS Pro), MapSys 10.x, QGIS, and OGC standards (PostGIS, GeoServer). We also generate XML/CGML files compliant with ANCPI e-Terra 3.
items.takeaway: Guaranteed 100% compatibility with Esri ArcGIS, MapSys, QGIS, and official ANCPI standards.

items.question: In what file formats can GIS project data be exported?
items.answer: We export spatial data in CAD vector formats (.DXF, .DWG), GIS formats (.SHP, .GeoJSON, File Geodatabase .GDB), ANCPI exchange formats (.XML, .CGML), and printable high-res PDF plans (.PDF, .TIFF).
items.takeaway: Flexible export options in DXF, DWG, SHP, GeoJSON, XML, CGML, and PDF.

categories.name: Pricing, Timelines & Consulting
categories.description: SEAP/SICAP public procurement, approvals, delivery times, and customized quotes.

items.question: How are cadastral and GIS services purchased via SEAP/SICAP?
items.answer: MEGAGIS SRL is registered on the Romanian Public Procurement Portal (SEAP/SICAP). For public contracting authorities, we provide technical advisory for drafting terms of reference, cost estimation, and direct contract publishing.
items.takeaway: Active on SEAP/SICAP with free technical assistance for drafting public tender specifications.

items.question: What are the typical turnaround times for surveying and large GIS projects?
items.answer: Individual topographical surveys and site plans take 1-3 business days on site, with OCPI review taking 7-15 business days (according to official ANCPI terms). Municipal systematic cadastre (PNCCF) or Green Space Register projects span 3 to 12 months according to contract milestones.
items.takeaway: Individual surveys: 2-5 days + OCPI review; Large municipal projects: 3-12 months.

items.question: How can I request a quote and initial technical consultation?
items.answer: You can request a tailored quote by calling us at +40 727 323 869, emailing office@megagis.ro, or filling out the contact form on our website. Initial document review and technical consulting are provided free of charge.
items.takeaway: Initial consulting is free. Contact us via phone, email, or online web form.
